# productivity-app-site

The built output of a local-first productivity app — a journal, garden, gym
log and food log that runs entirely in the visitor's own browser.

**This repository contains generated files only.** It is the deploy target for
GitHub Pages; the source lives in a separate private repository. Editing
anything here will be overwritten by the next build.

The app has no server and no database. Nothing you enter in it is transmitted
anywhere, and no operator — including whoever published this — can read it.
